errors.message:
CAMERA_SEGMENT_TOO_SHORT: Clip cam motion needs at least two frames A movement other than a hold needs at least 2 frames.
CAMERA_KEY_FRAME_ORDER: Clip cam segment 0 key 0 is at frame 0; keys must be strictly increasing, from frame 1 to frame 0 of the movement The keys of a movement must be at strictly increasing frames, from frame 1 to the movement's last frame. Move the key to a frame between its neighbours' frames.
CAMERA_DIRECTION_DEGENERATE: Clip cam target equals position The camera and its target are at the same point; move one of them.
INVALID_COMMAND: fovDeg: Too big: expected number to be <180
INVALID_COMMAND: fovDeg: Too small: expected number to be >0
